page.layout: One printed page: running head and page number at the top; one column of text, then a heading, a paragraph, a centred continuation and a closing Greek line below. The narrow strip at the far left is the edge of the facing page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: ponere intendat, tantum bulliri ista oportet, donec ad spissitudinem veniant: deinde adduntur liquores, ut vel oleum, adipes, butyrum, & huiusmodi iuxta Medici arbitrium, volētis vel digerere, vel suppurare. Si vero cum melle emplastrum sit componendum, pro lib. i. mell. speciērum unc. 4. admiscentur: compositum emplastrum, linteolo affectæ parti adhuc calidum illitum admoveatur.
main_text.head: De Cataplasmatis.
main_text.p: Cataplasmata ab emplastris differunt, quæ fiunt tantum è plantis viridibus contusis, vel ipsdem ad mollitudinē usq; in aqua decoctis. Ea absq; aliquo liquore pingui, hypochondrijs adhiberi solent, aliisq; partibus. Quæ suspecta semper sunt, nisi prius corpore vacuato.

page.notes: Ornament-like closing line is Greek; the reading of its second word is doubtful. The left strip shows the facing page's margin notes, which are cut off and not transcribed. Long s is normalised to s; u/v and i/j are normalised as specified.
